title: TiorAI AI Tool Category Taxonomy
description: One record per category, at either of two levels. The prose documentation of these fields is the Schema section of README.md; this file is the version a consumer validates against. Adding, removing, renaming, or retyping a field is a major version bump, so a diff of this file is a diff of the contract.

slug.description: Stable identifier, derived from the name and unique across both levels.

parent.description: Slug of the level-1 parent, or null at level 1.

level.description: 1 or 2. There is deliberately no level 3.

description.description: One sentence, 5 to 22 words, ending in a full stop.

aliases.description: Other names the same category goes by, including American spellings and common abbreviations.

children.description: Slugs of level-2 children. Empty at level 2.
